findings: BAR-CRITIQUE-01 gap rank 11 = G11 -> RI-WLD09 (opacity budget). Cross-rule: RI-WLD06 M29 scored only over quest destinations.

BAR-CRITIQUE-01 gap rank 12 = G12 -> RI-DLG08. Proposed 6 registers (deadpan, portentous, petty, cruel, absurd, bureaucratic), 18 exemplars; entropy >=2.0 bits; indifference ratio 0.45-0.75; bathos count >=6; hard fail any register >60%.
W1 (RI-WLD05): critique's own proposed change = <=12 of 30 in first 30 min, >=26 by hour 10, no 90-min window after hour 2 with zero first-time elements; delegate curve to RI-EXP04.

Structural non-address rate = 0.3723 (distinct) / 0.4054 (row-level). NOTE: BAR-CRITIQUE-01's proposed indifference band 0.45-0.75 uses THIS definition and MORROWIND FAILS IT (0.37). MEASURED subordination: 14.36% of sentences carry >=1 subordinator/relativiser; 0.163 subordinators per sentence; 20.10 per 1k words; 0.459 commas per sentence; 0.68 semicolons per 1k words. Morrowind is PARATACTIC, not subordinating.
MEASURED adjective proxy (suffix+closed-list heuristic) 4.65 per 100 words. Contractions 35.05/1k words, 44.3% of texts contain one -- Morrowind is NOT uniformly over-formal.

MEASURED modern idiom: NOT zero. 921 hits / 13.32 per 10k words across a 41-probe list. 'okay' 262 (249 distinct texts, in Morrowind.esm not just expansions), 'kind of' 183, 'whatever' 83, 'stuff' 79, 'guy' 47, 'yeah' 36. An absolute zero-idiom anti-register bar would fail Morrowind. Must be a calibrated band.

Chosen-one deference cannot be a zero bar: Morrowind has 11 such texts ('You are the Prophesied One'), but they are late-main-quest. The bar must be GATED by quest stage, not a count.
